title: Username validator
description: Check each username, in order, against three rules and use only the first rule it breaks: fewer than 3 characters is `too short`; more than 12 characters is `too long`; containing a space character is `has space`. For every failing username print one line `#POS [NAME]: REASON`, where POS is its position counted from 1 and NAME is the username exactly as given. Valid usernames print nothing. Return the number of failing usernames.

visible_examples.stdout:
#2 [ab]: too short
#3 [x y z]: has space

notes: Level 2. Rule order matters: 'a ' is too short (not has space) and a long name with spaces is too long. Lengths 3 and 12 are valid. Positions go past 9.
